description:
Love is... capturing! The Cat Prince's Secret Puppy Capture! Lee Ye-Won was suddenly evicted overnight due to dorm expansion. He drifted between friends' houses for a while, but as a shapeshifter, Ye-Won faced a desperate situation with nowhere to stay as his heat approached. That's when Ji Seung-Hu, a classmate and fellow shapeshifter, invited Ye-Won to stay in an empty room at his place. Staying at Seung-Hu's place, Ye-Won treats him to a meal and drinks as a token of gratitude... Only to wake up naked in the same bed the next morning.Instead of repaying the homeowner's kindness, he's in heat and caused a proper mess?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
